title: Iglesia y Estado
goal: Read how Colombia and Ecuador took the opposite path from Mexico, strengthening rather than weakening Church power for decades, and when each finally moved toward a secular state.

items: Explain how Ecuador and Colombia's path differed from Mexico's.
State what Ecuador's 1869 constitution required of citizens.
Describe what followed García Moreno's 1875 assassination.
Explain what Colombia's 1886 constitution and 1887 concordat reversed.
Use impersonal se to describe national-level decisions without naming an actor.
